# Color playfield references

- `popeye-main-color.webp`: Popeye Saves the Earth cabinet screenshot, TastyWasps and contributors (mfuegemann, JPJ Team PP, Psiomicron, MovieGuru, Hauntfreaks, DGrimmReaper, VPW). Source: https://vpuniverse.com/files/file/16143-popeye-saves-the-earth-bally-1994/
- `popeye-upper-color.webp`: upper playfield photograph, Russ N., via Pinball Rebel. Source: https://www.pinballrebel.com/game/pins/popeye/popeye_pinball.htm
- `t2-main-color.webp`: Terminator 2 cabinet screenshot from the g5k release discussion. Source: https://vpuniverse.com/forums/topic/6095-new-vp10-alert-terminator-2-williams-1991-g5k/

Images are stored locally as WebP; the viewer makes no third-party image requests. Attribution links also appear beside the tables. Original game artwork belongs to its respective owners.

The original manual coordinate data remains in `popeye-playfield.mjs` and `t2-playfield.mjs`. `color-playfield.mjs` registers it to the photographic views. Positions for mechanisms occluded by ramps or Popeye's upper deck are approximate; the switch matrix remains available for the complete input list. Illumination already visible in the reference artwork is static; live lamp indicators are added on top.
